item.title: 80 Curious Facts People Learned By Accident And Can’t Stop Thinking About (New Pics)
item.description: We go to school, study further, then learn new things in our chosen careers. But no matter how much knowledge we acquire, there always seems to be space in our brain for more. Sometimes we gather new information by choice. Other times it comes at us unexpectedly... like this list of interesting facts that people say they just recently learned.

item.title: 80 Hilarious Classical Art Memes That Show Human Struggle Hasn’t Changed In Centuries
item.description: Classical art memes are everywhere on the internet, and what makes them so funny is that they smash two completely different worlds and timelines together. You’ve got serious, yet dramatic, centuries-old paintings on one side and painfully relatable modern problems on the other. We’ve selected some of the most hilarious ones here, while also trying to understand the reason behind their popularity by talking to some meme experts.

item.title: 80 Unhinged Posts That Prove There Are Way Too Many Idiots On Reselling Shops
item.description: Buying and selling secondhand has never been easier. That unworn top in your closet? Someone wants it. Need a cute bag without the boutique price tag? A few clicks and it’s yours—or so it seems. Because the moment humans get involved in anything, things can go off the rails in the blink of an eye. That’s how buyers and sellers end up in wildly unhinged DM exchanges that feel like a chaotic movie scene. DM Drama on Instagram collects the best of it.

item.title: “That’s All?”: Husband Walks Out After Wife Responds With Logic Instead Of Drama
item.description: Unfettered, over-the-top jealousy can completely ruin your romantic relationship. And yet, you’ll still find some people who insist that if their significant others don’t get jealous, it supposedly means that they don’t love them. An anonymous, distraught woman bared her heart to the ‘TrueOffMyChest’ community after her husband left her. She shared how her spouse felt unloved because she wouldn’t get jealous when other women approached him.

item.title: “My Mom Went To The ER For Dirt On Her Forehead”: 38 Of The Funniest ER Visits
item.description: Going to the ER is never pleasant. In fact, most folks wouldn't choose it over many other activities. However, these people convinced themselves that something was wrong with them and went to the ER, even if it was for the dumbest reasons. Some may have been hypochondriacs, others just confused silly geese, yet their stories are just as entertaining.

item.title: Employee Loses It When Coworker Stops Delivering Lunches Because Of Him, Gets Terminated
item.description: While being kind to other people is the right thing to do, it has its fair share of pitfalls. Some will take advantage of the niceness you show them. It’s just how the world works. It’s something this employee experienced from their coworkers after offering to pick up everyone’s lunches. Fortunately, there is a satisfying end to this story. Read through to find out.
